why: The College Explorer is a named NWEA data-visualization tool that links MAP Growth scores to higher-education benchmarks, rather than a general instructional element.
This source describes the NWEA MAP Growth assessment and its longitudinal achievement database, so its evidence belongs on the existing canonical page.
The College Explorer is a named NWEA data-visualization tool rather than a general instructional element or a variant of the MAP Growth assessment pages.
name: College Explorer
product_description: College Explorer is a data-visualization tool from NWEA Research that links MAP Growth scores with national benchmarks for colleges, universities, and majors to support post-secondary planning.
